concepts.headline: The walk to my car used to take forever.
concepts.prompt: Tight low-angle crop of a nurse's legs in navy scrubs walking across a hospital parking lot at dusk with a car and a lamp post softly blurred behind, the black-purple shoe from the reference photo sharp in the foreground, about 50% of the frame. Huge heavy white headline at the top over the dark sky: "THE WALK TO MY CAR" / "USED TO TAKE FOREVER." One solid purple pill at the bottom with white text: "AFTER A 12-HOUR SHIFT". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin. No other text.

concepts.prompt: Clean white background. Huge heavy black headline at the top: "THREE NURSES" / "ON MY FLOOR ASKED." Right third: a nurse's leg in navy scrubs and the navy shoe from the reference photo, huge and sharp, overlapping the chat. At the bottom a solid royal blue block with three stacked large bold white lines: "40% OFF", "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE", "FREE SHIPPING". All supporting text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label, nothing small or thin. No other text.

Right half labeled with a big solid royal blue pill "4:00 PM": same plaza, the black-white shoe from the reference photo sharp and large, about 45% of the half, with a white check circle.
